Why a package is allowed or refused

Usage: byrle explain <--policy|--purl <PURL>|--npm <NAME@VERSION>>

Options:
      --policy              The policy in BYRLE_POLICY as loaded, and which checks can fire
      --purl <PURL>         One package version, for example pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21
      --npm <NAME@VERSION>  One npm package version as npm's errors print it, for example @babel/core@7.0.0
  -h, --help                Print help
